decision: No new locator. The project reuses the existing Polaris Forge 1 campus point (NDDEQ ELN Building 1 generator-plant coordinate, -98.574269, 46.014383). This file records the check that the APLD ELN-01 hosting facility's Outlot 4-1 and the PF1 buildings share one APLD-owned quarter section that contains that point.

selected_properties.note: Dickey County geometry identifiers in the statewide layer do not join to the 2024 tax-roll identifiers, so the four geometry parcels are matched to the four outlots only as a set: both total about 160 acres of the SE1/4 of Section 4.

computed.method: Statewide ND GIS Hub parcel polygons (WGS84) unioned with shapely; centroid in EPSG:32614; geodesic distances and areas on the WGS84 ellipsoid.

unresolved: Which of the two 40-acre geometry parcels is Outlot 4-1 is not resolved; either lies within about 0.63 km of the campus point.
The reused point locates the campus through the ELN Building 1 generator plant on Outlot 4-4; it does not locate the hosting buildings on Outlot 4-1.
